visual_elements.description: Flowchart of self-attention. Bottom: green dashed rounded rectangle containing four pink boxes labeled X1, X2, X3, X4; blue box above labeled 'X_i = X_2'; red arrow from X2 up to dot product. Left: green dashed rounded rectangle with four rows, each row has pink and yellow squares with 'X'; blue box above labeled 'X_1'; red lines from each row to four blue dots in dot product. Right: green dashed rounded rectangle with four rows, each row has pink and yellow squares with 'X'; red lines from each row to four multiplication circles. Center-left: gray rectangle labeled 'Dot Product' containing four blue dots; red lines from left rows to dots; red lines from dots to softmax. Center: vertical pink rectangle labeled 'Soft max'; red lines from softmax to multiplication circles. Center-right: four multiplication circles (×) with labels w_{21}, w_{22}, w_{23}, w_{24}; red lines from right rows to circles; red lines from circles up to blue rectangle with 'Σ'. Top center: green box 'y_i'; arrow from Σ to y_i. Stage labels 'Similarity', 'Probabilities', 'Weighted SUM' in light blue rounded rectangles above the dot-product, softmax, and weighted-sum stages. Top right: blue box with equation y_i = sum_j w_{ij} x_j. Bottom center: two blue boxes with equations w'_{ij} = x_i^T x_j and w_{ij} = exp(w'_{ij}) / sum_j exp(w'_{ij}). Red text 'Remember' near bottom right.

Table with three columns: 'Output layer', 'Softmax activation function', 'Probabilities'. Left column values: 1.3, 5.1, 2.2, 0.7, 1.1. Middle column equation: e^{z_i} / sum_{j=1}^K e^{z_j}. Right column values: 0.02, 0.90, 0.05, 0.01, 0.02. Arrows from left to middle to right.
Yellow highlight on '(Fundamental Operation)' in title.
